scope: Actual project Three.js GLTFLoader/AnimationMixer plus standard four-influence LBS and four additive POSITION/NORMAL targets. All declared30Hz surfaces streamed once in ascending time directly to native Blender BVH checks, no stored frame cache.
self_fold_policy: Localized exact nonadjacent self-fold counts and opposed shader normals are diagnostics. Root accepted bounded joint8 shape with residual joint creases; this is not a globally collision-free claim.
